column1: # Hand-curated additions to the generated gazetteer.
#   X  iso2  -    -    names   alias for a country (uses the country's label point); the first
#                              name replaces the country's display name
#   R  iso2  lat  lon  names   region / landmark / institution with its own coordinates
#   S  -     -    -    names   stoplist: never treat these words as places
# Names are matched as whole words. A trailing * means "word starts with" (for German adjectives,
# which are lower-case and inflected: russisch* matches russische, russischen, ...). ALL-CAPS
# names (US, UK) only match exactly that spelling. Other names must be capitalised in the text.
# A leading ~ marks a weak hint (people, parties): it counts half as much as a place name.
# Countries: common names, abbreviations, demonyms (EN) and adjective stems (DE)
